title: Cross-Channel Effects of Failure in a Retailer's Mobile App
eligible_reason: Single exogenous app failure on one date (April 11, 2018, 12-2 p.m. CT). Treated = users who tried to access the app during the failure window; control = users who accessed the app that day but outside the window. Equation 1 is a two-period (14 days pre vs 14 days post) 2x2 DiD with shopper-group FE and a pre/post time FE: only one adoption date, so no staggered cohorts. A second failure in November 2014 is analysed separately as robustness, not pooled into a multi-cohort panel.
design_notes: Eq. (1): Y_it = a0 + a1 F_i P_t + mu_i + lambda_t + nu_it, i = shopper, t = pre/post two-week period; 'shopper group FE' is treated/control indicator. N = 273,378 (70,568 treated, 66,121 control users in Table 2 descriptives; 136,689 users). Table 3 DID: frequency -.024 (.008), quantity -.057 (.020), value -2.181 (.681); SEs clustered/robust at individual level. Web Appendix Tables W8/W20 re-estimate with daily FE (28 obs per user) but still a single failure date.
estimators_reported: 2x2 DiD (two-way FE with group and pre/post FE)
screener_notes: Ineligible: single treatment date. Data are firm-provided transaction/app logs for a US consumer-electronics omnichannel retailer; no replication package in batch.
